data.title: Protolabs Named to Business Insider’s America’s Most Innovative Businesses 2027 List

data.title: Alvies Boot Company and Vince Young Launch “The VY” Collaboration
data.description: In Austin, Texas and Dallas, the Alvies Boot Company has introduced The VY, a unique cowboy boot produced in partnership with former NFL star Vince Young. This limited edition boot is hand-numbered and is now on sale at Alvies' online store. The launch follows the success of Young's Netflix documentary, Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young, which is currently one of the top 10 trending shows on the platform. The VY is a special release that combines the essence of Austin Originals Made with Soul with Young's legacy as a University of Texas icon.

data.title: SKENNEN'KÓ:WA KEN? (DO YOU CARRY GREAT PEACE?) OPENS TOMORROW AT 2026 GWANGJU BIENNALE
data.description: Curated by OCAD University, the Indigenous-led Canada Pavilion at the Toronto exhibit showcases artwork from alumni artists Shelley Niro, Melissa General, and Hannah Claus. Curator Ryan Rice leads this Kanien'kehá:ka-led exhibition, titled Skennen'kó:wa ken? (Do You Carry Great Peace?). This event, scheduled for September 4, 2026, celebrates Indigenous artistry and culture, offering a platform for diverse voices and perspectives.
